Shell(powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000/login -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; 'LOGIN: ' + $r.StatusCode; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000/dashboard -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -TimeoutSec 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; 'DASH: ' + $r2.StatusCode } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { 'DASH redirect to: ' + $_.Exception.Response.Headers.Location } else { $_.Exception.Message } }")

Shell(powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000/records -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -TimeoutSec 10 -ErrorAction Stop; 'STATUS: ' + $r.StatusCode } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if ($resp) { 'STATUS: ' + [int]$resp.StatusCode; 'LOCATION: ' + $resp.Headers['Location'] } else { 'ERR: ' + $_.Exception.Message } }")

Shell(powershell -Command "$session = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/csrf' -UseBasicParsing -WebSession $session -TimeoutSec 10; $csrf = ($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json).csrfToken; 'CSRF: ' + $csrf.Substring(0,20); $body = @{ csrfToken = $csrf; email = 'manager@fleet.test'; password = 'password123'; callbackUrl = '/dashboard'; json = 'true' }; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/credentials' -Method Post -UseBasicParsing -WebSession $session -Body $body -TimeoutSec 15 -ErrorAction Stop; 'LOGIN: ' + $r2.StatusCode; 'COOKIES:'; $session.Cookies.GetCookies('http://localhost:3000') | ForEach-Object { $_.Name + '=' + $_.Value.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(20, $_.Value.Length)) + '...' } } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if ($resp) { 'STATUS: ' + [int]$resp.StatusCode } else { $_.Exception.Message } }")

Shell(powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/providers' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; 'PROVIDERS: ' + $r.StatusCode + ' ' + $r.Content } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if ($resp) { $s = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($resp.GetResponseStream()); 'STATUS: ' + [int]$resp.StatusCode + ' BODY: ' + $s.ReadToEnd() } else { 'ERR: ' + $_.Exception.Message } }")

Shell(powershell -Command "$session = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/csrf' -UseBasicParsing -WebSession $session -TimeoutSec 10; $csrf = ($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json).csrfToken; 'CSRF OK'; $body = @{ csrfToken = $csrf; email = 'manager@fleet.test'; password = 'password123'; callbackUrl = '/dashboard'; json = 'true' }; $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/credentials' -Method Post -UseBasicParsing -WebSession $session -Body $body -TimeoutSec 15 -ErrorAction Stop; 'LOGIN: ' + $r2.StatusCode; 'COOKIES:'; $session.Cookies.GetCookies('http://localhost:3000') | ForEach-Object { $_.Name } } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if ($resp) { $s = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($resp.GetResponseStream()); 'STATUS: ' + [int]$resp.StatusCode + ' BODY: ' + $s.ReadToEnd().Substring(0,300) } else { 'ERR: ' + $_.Exception.Message } }")
